verdicts.rationale: Same title, author, year (1981), and DOI 10.1037/0033-295x.88.1.46. Loser is an incollection variant of the same Psychological Review article.

All three are 'The Case for Mental Imagery' (Kosslyn/Thompson/Ganis, 2006, OUP). Two share the DOI; the third shares ISBN 9780195179088. The kosslyn1995mental citekey is a mislabeled shadow key but its fields are the same 2006 book.
Identical title, author, year, journal, volume, and DOI. Zotero-style key vs hand key for the same article.
Same title, author, year, volume, pages, and DOI. Loser noted as 'Preprint (manuscript)' — preprint vs published is the same work.
Identical fields including DOI. Zotero-style key vs hand key for the same Journal of Semantics article.
Identical title, year, journal, and DOI; only author-name formatting differs. Same work.
Identical title, year, journal, volume, pages, and DOI. Same work under two citekeys.

'Naming and Necessity' — survivor is the 1972 chapter in Semantics of Natural Language; losers are the 1980 Harvard standalone edition (same ISBN twice). Same work republished; no member is independently indexed, so merging risks no real work.

The survivor is Shepard's 1994 Psychonomic Bulletin & Review paper (vol 1, pp 2-28, DOI 10.3758/bf03200759). The loser shepard2001perceptual is the distinct 2001 Behavioral and Brain Sciences target article (vol 24, pp 581-601, DOI 10.1017/s0140525x01000012) — different journal, year, volume, pages, and DOI. Distinct publications despite the shared title.
Same title, author, year, journal, volume, and DOI. Loser merely adds page range. Same work.
Identical title, author, year, journal, volume, pages, and DOI. Same work under two citekeys.
'Images' (Kulvicki, 2013, Routledge, ISBN 9780415557009) — kulvicki2013images vs kulvicki2014images are the same book under two citekeys with identical metadata.
